rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the patchiness means interruptions or gaps over time.

example.english: The rain has been patchy lately, so the clothes never dry properly.
example.traditional: 呢排落雨斷斷續續，搞到啲衫成日晾唔乾。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 lok6 jyu5 tyun5 tyun5 zuk6 zuk6 gaau2 dou3 di1 saam1 seng4 jat6 long6 m4 gon1

rows.note: Use this for patchiness caused by scattered or sparse occurrences, especially clouds or other things spread across an area.

example.english: The clouds are patchy today, and they look nice in photos.
example.traditional: 今日啲雲零零星星，影相幾靚。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 wan4 ling4 ling4 sing1 sing1 jing2 soeng2 gei2 leng3

rows.note: Use this when something is visibly covered in separate patches or blotches.

example.english: My white shirt got patchy from bleach.
example.traditional: 我件白恤衫俾漂白水整到一撻撻。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin6 baak6 seot1 saam1 bei2 piu3 baak6 seoi2 zing2 dou3 jat1 taat3 taat3
